description: List the dances and effects a pet photo can be turned into, instead of a singing video. Dances (kind dance) make the pet dance to a song: trending dances, legendary ones and fun moves. Effects (kind effect) make something happen to the pet, with sound the video model makes itself. Call this before create_move_video to get a valid move slug; each move's template_id field says whether it needs a song from list_song_templates (required), may take one in place of its own (optional), or takes none (not_allowed).

kind.description: Only dances (the pet dances to a song) or only effects (something happens to the pet, with its own sound). Both when left out.

name: list_moves
title: List dances and effects
